verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Bun's package manager works across platforms (e.g., using hardlinks on Linux and Windows for node_modules) and workspaces/lockfile behavior is described generically without platform caveats, implying a uniform config/workflow. However, community reports specific Windows-related bugs (crashes tied to lockfiles/node_modules when switching WSL/Windows) and Windows-specific performance differences, showing the cross-platform experience isn't perfectly uniform. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of macOS/Linux/Windows parity testing, and resolution of the Windows-specific install bugs reported by users.
